decisions.subject: Reference geometry derivation for ROW, easements, wetland, and street edges

value.method: dimensioned and visually digitized from City Appendix A maps against City GIS taxlot coordinates

decisions.rationale: The official appendix confirms location and dimensions but expressly labels mapped GIS data imprecise/general-reference. Geometry is frozen for repeatable test data without claiming survey authority.

decisions.subject: Reviewed-assumption apartment building and pad footprint
decisions.rationale: A compact 45-by-90-foot bar follows the prior research concept, fits east of the reference wetland and west of the reference ROW, and avoids all modeled constraints. Clearances prove geometry separation only; they are not code setbacks or approvals.

decisions.subject: Exterior entries and future utility wall terminals
decisions.rationale: Stable wall interfaces let later systems connect to one building contract without implying routes, sizes, capacities, inverts, or approved penetrations.
